title: Watcher governance is not universal Atlas law
issue_presented: May Clerk/Magistrate overlay over LA/WI watcher JSON be treated as universal Atlas Governance?

known_facts.fact: run_governance_overlay.py reads LA/WI staging JSON and writes overlay reports. It does not scrape and has no job_id intake.
Task 3: overlay did not govern Jobs 0–2 or Task 3 decisions.
Task 1 F-07: Magistrate is still live in overlay code.

analysis: Useful watcher behavior is preserved in place. It must be labeled WATCHER-ONLY so it cannot silently become universal law, and universal V2 must not redesign working watchers.
judgment_rule: GENERAL ATLAS GOVERNANCE is this V2 repository after cutover.
WATCHER-SPECIFIC GOVERNANCE is the Clerk/Magistrate overlay and watcher GitHub workflows that govern LA/WI/APN watcher packets.
A workflow that exists specifically to govern watcher output must not automatically become universal Atlas law.
Universal Atlas Governance must not accidentally break working watcher workflows.
Magistrate overlay remains watcher-only; it is not deleted; it is not Atlas-wide current law.
operational_effect: watcher/README.md is the classification. Engine rejects treating overlay reports as CURRENT_LAW.
exceptions: Watcher jobs may still be *recorded* as V2 jobs that *cite* overlay outputs as evidence.
supersedes: any reading of overlay as statute
